heard: The seventh day the wine was bright, the king commanded eunuchs to the light To bring the queen with royal crown, to show her beauty to the town But Queen Vashti refused to come, her face against the king's command The anger burned within his heart, a crisis set the court apart He sought the wise who knew the times to judge the matter in the lines For it was custom for the king to ask the laws on which he claimed Karshina, Shiva, Radmatha, Tarshish, Mer and Marcina With Memucan the seven men holding the highest ranks again Amen.
